title: Redactor times out on a large git diff and the output passes unredacted
reason_not_testable: The assertion depends on hook timeout and failure handling inside Claude Code at runtime. The fixture format has no hook-timeout or hook-config knob, and an ~8 MB git log cannot be carried in a fixture. Behaviour is UNVERIFIED per the case (fail-open per https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks). No non-hook control is documented; mitigation is the case's own note that replacement via updatedToolOutput is the only documented withholding path.
